@Bettina Kroll: The official handoff of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to Kwame was **November 3, 2025**. Moss's Coastal digest from Nov 2, 2025 gives that date.

Your own cutover recap (Dec 8, 2025) says you kept running the account day to day until Nov 21, and Kwame fully took over on **Nov 22, 2025**. If the tracker needs the day-to-day transfer rather than the official one, use Nov 22.
